page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: the large title ORATIO LVGVBRIS, the subtitle block in smaller capitals and italic, the imprint, a woodcut ornament, and the imprint lines at the foot. No running head, page number or margin notes.

main_text.l: NVTRICII, IN PRIMIS VERÒ INCLYTÆ ACA-
Memoria tua quasi mixtura quadam odora-

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the motto and the imprint, not transcribed. Library oval stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München), manuscript shelf marks and annotations in the upper right and left, and the pencilled "582a" at the foot are not printed text and are omitted. The long s is rendered as s throughout. The date line "ANNO cIO IO XCII." is read as printed; the reversed-C numerals are rendered in the printed form, and the exact glyphs are slightly uncertain.
